**wikibaser** provides a lightweight R interface to the
[MediaWiki Action API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page)
for working with [Wikibase](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikibase)
repositories and [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/).

The package supports reproducible retrieval, transformation and
validation of structured, multilingual knowledge from public and
authenticated repositories.

## Features

- Retrieve items and properties through the `wbgetentities` API module.
- Cache original JSON responses for reproducible and offline retrieval.
- Extract multilingual labels, descriptions and aliases into tables.
- Extract statement values and analyse their distribution.
- Authenticate with Wikibase and upload files to MediaWiki.

## Installation

```{r installation, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("dataobservatory-eu/wikibaser")
```

## Example

Retrieve multilingual descriptions of
[Q42 (Douglas Adams)](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q42)
using the bundled Wikidata cache.

```{r example}
library(wikibaser)

cache <- wb_entity_cache(
  path = system.file(
    "extdata", "wikidata-cache",
    package = "wikibaser"
  ),
  max_age_hours = Inf
)

wb_entity_description(
  "Q42",
  cache = cache,
  languages = c("mul", "az", "en", "hu")
)
```

The example uses a saved API response and does not require a live
connection to Wikidata. The saved entity may differ from its current
Wikidata revision.

See the vignette *Reproducible retrieval of Wikibase entities*
for further examples.

## Development status

**wikibaser** is experimental and under active development.
Future development will focus on entity editing and federation
between Wikibase repositories and Wikidata.

Contributions, bug reports and feature requests are welcome
via the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/dataobservatory-eu/wikibaser/issues).

```{r}
citation("wikibaser")
```
